facts.fact: Oliver 躲进洗手间自我审问：那句临场的 Good girl 到底是什么鬼东西。
facts.anchor: Good girl? Jesus Christ, what’s wrong with me?

facts.fact: 出发前的小赌局：Eden 押 Oliver 不喜欢 Gemma 特调，结果输了十美元，嘟嘴告负。
Eden 抓他的手挤过人群去吧台，Oliver 用「怕走散」当借口，贪恋手心温度。
facts.anchor: My stomach flips as she takes my hand, making our way to the bar.

facts.fact: 舞池初吻：她的味道是覆盆子、青柠、以及「家」。
facts.anchor: She tastes like raspberries. She tastes like lime. She tastes like home.

facts.fact: 吻毕睁眼她脸色煞白，Oliver 当场定罪自己：越界了。
facts.anchor: She’s pale. Really pale. Wide eyes meet mine. I’ve overstepped.

facts.fact: Eden 的原话——说完立刻吐了，全书最浪漫一刻被喜剧急刹。
facts.anchor: I think I’m going to be sick.

facts.fact: Misty 场外知情放行：别担心，你和 Eden 的事我知道——当晚托付成立。
facts.anchor: Don’t worry. I know about you and Eden.

facts.fact: 浴室里 Eden 咕哝「对不起，Ollie」——首次叫出昵称，本人毫无自觉。
facts.anchor: unaware of her first use of my nickname

facts.fact: 编发是妈妈教的：小时候给妈妈编发是他最爱的差事之一。
facts.anchor: My mum taught me how to braid when I was little and doing her hair was always one of my favourite things.
